column3: requireActorActive (actor_active.go, #4159) reads only the acting user's own account row, not state of the secret RotateSecret writes, so it is an actor-authority check. The gap includes the upstream backend rotation call, so a suspension can arrive mid-rotation and the rotation still commits; that is still a legal serial order (rotate started before the suspend). The check only narrows what the function allowed before #4159. Covers this check only.
